evidence: SoundHound's voice AI delivers best-in-class speed and accuracy in numerous languages to product creators across automotive, TV, and IoT, and to customer service industries via groundbreaking AI-driven products like Smart Answering, Smart Ordering, and Dynamic Interaction
SoundHound Chat AI, a powerful voice assistant with integrated Generative AI, SoundHound powers millions of products and services, and processes billions of interactions each year
The SoundHound developer platform, Houndify, is an open-access platform that allows developers to leverage SoundHound's Voice AI technology and a library of over 100 content domains

Our technology is backed by significant investments in intellectual property, with over 359 patents granted and over 102 patents pending, spanning multiple fields including speech recognition, natural language understanding, machine learning
We believe that Voice AI will be the next major technology disruption in computing
ai_positioning.summary: SoundHound se positionne comme leader en Voice AI avec ses propres modèles propriétaires (Chat AI, Generative AI Foundation Model) qu'il commercialise via une plateforme ouverte (Houndify) à grande échelle auprès de millions de produits et services.
